headline: Mooring County Goes Quiet as Wardens Hold Every Post
war_summary: The picture shifted again inside three hours. Mooring County, where Colonials still held two posts at our last edition, now flies the Warden flag over all twelve; the day's forty-seven actions and some 7,200 Colonial against 7,600 Warden casualties gave way to near silence in the final two hours. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's furnace — seventy-three actions, Wightwalk and Frostmarch busiest, seven Warden posts standing and two in ruin, the day's dead near 10,200 Colonial and 11,700 Warden, the latest bloodletting inside the hour. The Nevish Line saw flag movement at last, Colonials taking Grief Mother to stand at two posts against six, with losses past 5,000 a side. Stlican Shelf's last Warden post fell, leaving nine to the Colonials as the fire there cools. Linn Mercy raised no new flag since Lathair, yet its ledger — 5,391 Colonial, 10,649 Warden — still climbs hourly. Fresh fighting flared at Palantine Berm, sixteen actions splitting its posts three and three with one ruined, the latest logged at the hour. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua took seventeen actions, while Kuura Strand's eruption died away with all six Warden posts intact. Day 580; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
